paras: The ADRO V2 carbon fibre hood is designed to give the G8X M3 and M4 a more aggressive and refined front-end look.

Compared to our V1 hood, V2 features a more sculpted design with deeper vent openings and a stronger center section. These changes add visual depth and better match the sharp lines of the G8X chassis while maintaining a clean, OEM-plus appearance.
ft: ADRO Dry Carbon Fibre Hood V2 for BMW G80 G81 M3 / G82 G83 M4 2020+
